profile.name: PI E-816B 压电定位控制器
profile.description: 用于控制压电定位器或压电位移台的精密位置移动与读回，提供绝对移动、当前位置查询和行程范围查询，适合显微成像、精密扫描与对焦定位等实验场景。
profile.description_en: A piezo positioning controller used to drive and read back a piezo actuator or piezo stage. It supports absolute moves, current position queries, and travel-range queries for microscopy, precision scanning, and focus positioning experiments.
